package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type LearningSessionSummaryService struct {
	repository domain.LearningSessionSummaryRepository
}

func NewLearningSessionSummaryService(repository domain.LearningSessionSummaryRepository) *LearningSessionSummaryService {
	return &LearningSessionSummaryService{repository: repository}
}

func (service *LearningSessionSummaryService) Get(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID uuid.UUID) (*domain.LearningSessionSummary, error) {
	if service == nil || service.repository == nil || studentID == uuid.Nil || sessionID == uuid.Nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("student_id and session_id are required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	return service.repository.GetLearningSessionSummary(ctx, studentID, sessionID)
}
